# 1618 Digital

> Berlin web and software studio. We build websites and custom software for restaurants, cafés, event businesses and local companies (SMEs) in Berlin and across Germany — online booking and reservation systems, digital QR menus and TV menu boards, customer portals and business dashboards, and lead/process automation — plus film, drone and social media content from the same team. We work in German, English and Turkish.

The site is a client-rendered app; the pages below carry the full content.

## Services

- [Web Design & SaaS Development](https://1618-digital.de/web-saas-development): websites, web apps, booking systems, customer portals and SaaS MVPs. Landing pages typically take 2–3 weeks; business platforms 6–10 weeks.
- [QR Code Menus & Digital Menu Boards](https://1618-digital.de/digital-menus): QR menus guests open at the table and animated TV menu boards, both from one menu source, in several languages.
- [Wedding & Event Films](https://1618-digital.de/wedding-event-films)
- [Video & Drone Production](https://1618-digital.de/video-drone-production)
- [Social Media Marketing & Content](https://1618-digital.de/social-media-marketing)

## How a project runs

1. Free intro call (20–30 minutes, phone, WhatsApp or in person).
2. Concept and a written quote with fixed scope and price before any work starts.
3. Design and build with regular preview links.
4. Launch, team handover and ongoing support.
